name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.

Godfrey and the Potter are in the same ward.
The artisan in Highrow and the artisan in Eastcheap are in different guilds.
Rowan, Carpenter, and Oldwall belong to different artisans.
The Fletcher belongs to the River Ward.
